expected_outputs: All cases declare explicit data/value/DB effects before execution; none has a status-only or generic fallback expectation.

requirements.evidence: All 52 test functions document Arrange, Act, Assert/CheckDB and Rollback; every helper function has a purpose docstring. Compound one-line statements were expanded and formatted.
Exact # Test Case ID comments match all 589 executed cases in their own scripts; registries are grouped by test function.

Abbreviated domain variables were replaced with names such as hotel, room, booking, payment, serializer, sample_data and related_services. No one- or two-letter domain variable remains; standard imported module aliases are excluded from this check.

GET contracts compare independently selected IDs, record values and ordering. A second distinct fixture graph tests record exclusion. Reads/validation compare before/after snapshots. Invalid HTTP writes compare every persisted row/field; CRUD updates verify unchanged fields and foreign keys. Business discrepancies remain failed tests.

requirements.requirement: Rollback to the before-test data state
requirements.evidence: All 589 teardown audits compare model and automatic M2M table values before/after savepoint rollback; no setup/teardown errors were recorded. pytest-django provides an additional outer rollback.

scope_limit: This verifies the selected unit scripts and isolated SQLite execution. It does not claim that every application requirement passes or that live services/MySQL/concurrency have been validated.
